name: The St. Regis Changsha
positioning: St. Regis hotel at Yunda Central Plaza in Changsha's Yuhua District, with city-view rooms decorated with subtle Chinese touches and butler service at any hour
best_for: Travelers who want St. Regis Butler Service any time, day or night
Diners who want Cantonese, Hunan and Japanese cooking under one roof

facts.text: The hotel is at Yunda Central Plaza, No. 289 Shawan Road, in Changsha's Yuhua District.
Changsha Huanghua International Airport is about 18 kilometers from the hotel.
The nearest subway station is Changsha Avenue, on Line 2.
Guest rooms and suites have sweeping views of the city.
The rooms are designed and decorated with subtle Chinese touches.
Rooms have an iPad remote control and a surround sound system.
Yan Ting serves Cantonese cuisine with a modern presentation, alongside authentic Hunan dishes.
Social has an open kitchen that combines a buffet with live cooking.
The St. Regis Afternoon Tea in the lobby-level Drawing Room adds a local twist to traditions from the 1800s.
The St. Regis Athletic Club fitness center has city views.
The fitness center has sauna rooms and steam rooms.
The Grand Ballroom spans about 2,000 square meters.

highlights.text: Un, the Japanese restaurant, has five private rooms, three of which can accommodate live cooking, and a menu of fresh sushi and sashimi.
The St. Regis Bar pays homage to the King Cole Bar in New York City and serves The St. Regis Bloody Mary.
At The St. Regis Bar, bottles of Champagne are opened by sabering.
St. Regis Butler Service is available any time, day or night.
The swimming pool is on the top level and is an indoor infinity pool.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; a Rolls-Royce limousine transfer is available on request for a fee.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may be less convenient for leisure attractions.
